title: Memorandum: Destroyed Leased Equipment under ComfortLease Equipment Leases
content:
**Subject:** settlement when equipment under a ComfortLease Equipment Leases agreement is destroyed

Equipment destroyed while it is leased is settled on the loss payment basis, with the system's equipment value as the insured value. On every ComfortLease system the loss payment basis is the buyout price for the current lease year less insurance proceeds paid to Harbison.

## Insured values

| Leased system | Insured value of the installed system | Loss payment basis |
|---|---|---|
| ComfortLease Gas Furnace | $5600.00 | Buyout price for the current lease year less insurance proceeds paid to Harbison |
| ComfortLease Central Air | $6900.00 | Same basis |
| ComfortLease Heat Pump | $8700.00 | Same basis |
| ComfortLease Furnace & Central Air | $12900.00 | Same basis |
| ComfortLease Dual-Fuel System | $15900.00 | Same basis |
| ComfortLease Ductless Multi-Zone | $13200.00 | Same basis |

The insured value is the installed value of the leased system used for insurance and loss claims.

## The settlement in parts

- **Starting figure:** the buyout price that applies to the lease year in effect when the loss is settled.
- **Deduction:** the insurance proceeds that have been paid to Harbison for the destroyed equipment.
- **What the lessee owes:** the starting figure less the deduction.

## Worked figures (hypothetical amounts)

| Hypothetical current-year buyout price | Hypothetical insurance proceeds paid to Harbison | Lessee owes |
|---|---|---|
| $4040.00 | $3500.00 | $540.00 |
| $4040.00 | $0.00 | $4040.00 |
| $9460.00 | $9000.00 | $460.00 |

The amounts in this table are illustrations chosen for the arithmetic; they are not prices or proceeds of any actual lease.
